worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.summary: Erupts a dome of pitch-blackness that races outward in rings: foes around the user (airborne ones included) each take a shock wave, are pushed away, and may be left shrouded and less accurate. Eclipse spreads wider and lingers longer; the burst form is heavier and shoves close foes farther.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.use.0: Shroud the whole circle of foes around you when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.use.1: Catch airborne targets together with grounded ones
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.use.2: Drag down a whole ring of foes' accuracy to buy room to retreat or counter
Every enemy the wave engulfs takes about %1$s special damage and has a %2$s chance to be shrouded and lose %3$s Accuracy stage(s).
Centred on the user, the wave spans %1$s blocks and reaches %2$s blocks up (airborne enemies are engulfed too), pushing outward from the feet in %3$s rings.
A caught enemy is shoved up to %1$s blocks away from the centre; the whole wave engulfs up to %2$s enemies, and each enemy is settled only once.

While shrouded the target's physical attack is 18%% lower and the darkness lasts %1$s; the Accuracy stages it lost stay like ordinary stat stages and only return when the target disengages, not when the darkness fades.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.eclipse.on: Eclipse: radius ×1.35, +2 foes, shroud chance +8%, shroud duration ×1.4 and two more advance steps (slower spread); costs power ×0.78, +4 ticks wind-up, +8 ticks cooldown and a gentler shove.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.eclipse.off: Burst: power ×1.12, radius ×0.85, a stronger shove and one fewer advance step (faster spread); costs shroud chance −6%.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.growth.0: From level %1$s the wave power rises to %2$s and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.growth.1: From level %1$s the wave power rises to %2$s and the shroud chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.preference.e: On: wave radius ×1.35, +2 foes, shroud chance +8%, shroud duration ×1.4 and two more advance steps (slower spread), for blanketing a whole ring; costs power ×0.78, +4 ticks wind-up, +8 ticks cooldown and a gentler shove. Off (burst): power ×1.12, radius ×0.85, a stronger shove and one fewer advance step, at the cost of shroud chance −6%.
worldcombat.skill.nightdaze.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user will not step into the crowd and closes in first. Larger prefers to approach before erupting.
Only worth erupting when at least this many foes stand inside the user's radius. Lower fires more readily (even for one), higher is pickier about crowds.
